AthenaNoEncryption.^description: Query results are not encrypted for this Athena workgroup. Without encryption, query results stored in S3 are readable by anyone with access to the output bucket. Enable SSE_KMS or CSE_KMS encryption to protect query results at rest.
AthenaNoEncryption.shortDesc: Enable encryption for Athena query results

AthenaNoKMSEncryption.^description: This Athena workgroup uses SSE_S3 encryption instead of KMS. While SSE_S3 provides encryption, KMS gives you control over key rotation, access auditing, and the ability to revoke access by disabling the key.
AthenaNoKMSEncryption.shortDesc: Use KMS encryption instead of SSE_S3 for Athena

AthenaNoOutputLocation.^description: No default output location is configured for this Athena workgroup. Without a default output location, users must specify one for every query, which can lead to inconsistent result storage and makes it harder to manage query results centrally.
AthenaNoOutputLocation.shortDesc: Set default output location for Athena workgroup

AthenaNotEnforced.^description: Workgroup configuration is not enforced. When not enforced, individual users can override workgroup settings including encryption, output location, and query limits. Enforcing workgroup configuration ensures consistent security and cost controls.

AthenaNoCloudWatchMetrics.^description: CloudWatch metrics publishing is disabled for this Athena workgroup. Without metrics, you cannot monitor query performance, data scanned, or set alarms on query costs. Enable metrics for operational visibility.
AthenaNoCloudWatchMetrics.shortDesc: Enable CloudWatch metrics for Athena workgroup

AthenaRequesterPaysDisabled.^description: Requester pays is not enabled for this workgroup. If querying data in requester-pays S3 buckets, this setting must be enabled otherwise queries will fail. This is informational for workgroups that access requester-pays buckets.
AthenaRequesterPaysDisabled.shortDesc: Consider enabling requester pays if accessing such buckets

AthenaNoBytesScannedLimit.^description: No bytes scanned cutoff is configured for this workgroup. Without a limit, a single poorly written query can scan terabytes of data and incur significant costs ($5 per TB scanned). Set a cutoff to prevent expensive runaway queries.
AthenaNoBytesScannedLimit.shortDesc: Set bytes scanned limit to prevent costly Athena queries

AthenaOldEngineVersion.^description: This workgroup is using Athena engine version 2. Athena engine version 3 provides better query performance, additional SQL features, and improved cost efficiency. Consider upgrading for better performance.

AthenaWorkgroupDisabled.^description: This Athena workgroup is not in ENABLED state. Disabled workgroups cannot run queries. If this workgroup is no longer needed, consider deleting it. If it should be active, enable it.
